name: Port the assets, physics, rendering, audio, overlay and debug namespaces

comments.text: Part 2a: rendering (camera, renderer, screen), audio and overlay are in. Assets, physics and debug come next.

Part 2b adds lantern::textures, lantern::meshes, lantern::physics (RayHit, ControllerStep and CharacterController as host object types) and lantern::debug. Tested in tests/host/assets-and-debug-drawing-reach-the-renderer and tests/host/a-character-controller-lands-on-the-course.
